'''Mike d'Amboise''' is a founding-circle member of [[Team Albany]].<ref name="clone1">[https://media.swccgstore.com/2018/09/03/the-voice-of-the-force-interview-with-swccg-documentary-directors/ The Voice of the Force: Interview with SWCCG Documentary Directors], Clone 1 with Brian Terwilliger and Brandon Baity, SWCCG Store (3 September 2018). "We randomly stumbled upon a shop in a dingy mall and met a guy name Johnny Chu (he traded me an IG-2000 for my Avenger; lol). He told us about a group of players who had events weekly. A few months later we moved to the Capital Region and joined the likes of Matt Sokol, Aaron Kingery and Mike D’amboise… ‘Team Albany’ was born."</ref> He played in 2025 Players Committee constructed events.<ref name="pc-2025">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025/ 2025 Morristown Melee], starwarsccg.org</ref>
